test_title: PYST 53: SSC GD Constable 2024 - Reasoning (Held On: 30 Mar, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
After interchanging the given two signs what will be the values of equation (I) and (II) respectively?

× and -

I. 7 × 8 - 6 + 15 ÷ 3

II. 8 - 9 × 2 + 45 ÷ 5
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4ee2498bba297a39279203bbd9638c58f354e0d2fc2d8db79c5e25b11859993e.png] 

Given : × and -

I. 7 × 8 - 6 + 15 ÷ 3

After interchanging the given two signs we get

⇒ 7 - 8 × 6 + __**15 ÷ 3**__

⇒ 7 - __**8 × 6**__ + 5

**⇒ __7 - 48 + 5__ = -36**

II. 8 - 9 × 2 + 45 ÷ 5

After interchanging the given two signs we get

⇒ 8 × 9 - 2 + __**45 ÷ 5**__

⇒ __**8 × 9 **__- 2 + 9

⇒ __**72 - 2 + 9**__ = **79**

Hence, the correct answer is "-36 and 79".
